1579-lysis.title: Lysis
1579-lysis.creator: Plato
1579-lysis.description: A book by Plato. no good; and he can only do them good by knowledge; and as he is still without knowledge, he can have as yet no conceit of knowledge. In this manner Socrates reads a lesson to Hippothales, the foolish lover of Lysis, respecting the style of conversation which he should address to his beloved.

71984-an-introductory-lecture-on-arch-ol.creator: Unknown

arxiv-1409-7541.title: A + A → ∅ A+A\rightarrow\emptyset model with a bias towards nearest neighbor
arxiv-1409-7541.creator: Parongama Sen, Purusattam Ray
arxiv-1409-7541.description: Abstract We have studied A + A → ∅ A+A\rightarrow\emptyset reaction-diffusion model on a ring, with a bias ϵ \epsilon ( 0 ≤ ϵ ≤ 0.5 ) (0\leq\epsilon\leq 0.5) of the random walkers A A to hop towards their nearest neighbor.

arxiv-2008-04986.title: MOVESTAR: An Open-Source Vehicle Fuel and Emission Model based on USEPA MOVES
arxiv-2008-04986.creator: Ziran Wang, Guoyuan Wu, George Scora
arxiv-2008-04986.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce an open-source model ‘‘MOVESTAR’’ to calculate the fuel consumption and pollutant emissions of motor vehicles. This model is developed based on U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s (EPA) Motor Vehicle Emission Simulator (MOVES), which provides an accurate estimate of vehicle fuel consumption and pollutant emissions under a wide range of user-defined conditions.

arxiv-2104-02691.title: Localizing Visual Sounds the Hard Way
arxiv-2104-02691.creator: Honglie Chen, Weidi Xie, Triantafyllos Afouras, Arsha Nagrani Andrea Vedaldi, Andrew Zisserman {hchen, weidi, afourast, arsha, vedaldi, az}@robots.ox.ac.uk VGG, Department of Engineering Science, University of Oxford, UK http://www.robots.ox.ac.uk/~vgg/research/lvs/
arxiv-2104-02691.description: Abstract The objective of this work is to localize sound sources that are visible in a video without using manual annotations. Our key technical contribution is to show that, by training the network to explicitly discriminate challenging image fragments, even for images that do contain the object emitting the sound, we can significantly boost the localization performance.

arxiv-2208-05774.title: On three problems of Y.–G. Chen Thanks: *Corresponding author
arxiv-2208-05774.creator: Yuchen Ding
arxiv-2208-05774.description: Abstract . In this short note, we answer two questions of Chen and Ruzsa negatively and answer a problem of Ma and Chen affirmatively. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 11A41. 1. Two problems on r –full numbers The irrationalities of certain type numbers are of great interest to mathematicians.

arxiv-2209-14261.title: Focused Adaptation of Dynamics Models for Deformable Object Manipulation
arxiv-2209-14261.creator: Peter Mitrano, Alex LaGrassa, Oliver Kroemer, Dmitry Berenson
arxiv-2209-14261.description: Abstract In order to efficiently learn a dynamics model for a task in a new environment, one can adapt a model learned in a similar source environment. However, existing adaptation methods can fail when the target dataset contains transitions where the dynamics are very different from the source environment.

arxiv-2308-14030.title: Forensic Histopathological Recognition via a Context-Aware MIL Network Powered by Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2308-14030.creator: Chen Shen, Jun Zhang, Xinggong Liang, Zeyi Hao, Kehan Li, Fan Wang (✉), Zhenyuan Wang (✉), Chunfeng Lian (✉)
arxiv-2308-14030.description: Abstract Forensic pathology is critical in analyzing death manner and time from the microscopic aspect to assist in the establishment of reliable factual bases for criminal investigation. In practice, even the manual differentiation between different postmortem organ tissues is challenging and relies on expertise, considering that changes like putrefaction and autolysis could significantly change typical histopathological appearance.

arxiv-2309-10426.title: Multi-Object Graph Affordance Network: Goal-Oriented Planning through Learned Compound Object Affordances
arxiv-2309-10426.creator: Tuba Girgin 1,2 and Emre Uğur 1
arxiv-2309-10426.description: Abstract Learning object affordances is an effective tool in the field of robot learning. While the data-driven models investigate affordances of single or paired objects, there is a gap in the exploration of affordances of compound objects composed of an arbitrary number of objects.

arxiv-2403-07588.title: Visual Privacy Auditing with Diffusion Models
arxiv-2403-07588.creator: Kristian Schwethelm k.schwethelm@tum.de, Johannes Kaiser johannes.kaiser@tum.de, Moritz Knolle moritz.knolle@tum.de, Sarah Lockfisch sarah.lockfisch@tum.de, Daniel Rückert daniel.rueckert@tum.de, Alexander Ziller alex.ziller@tum.de
arxiv-2403-07588.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kristian Schwethelm k.schwethelm@tum.de, Johannes Kaiser johannes.kaiser@tum.de, Moritz Knolle moritz.knolle@tum.de, Sarah Lockfisch sarah.lockfisch@tum.de, Daniel Rückert daniel.rueckert@tum.de, Alexander Ziller alex.ziller@tum.de. Data reconstruction attacks on machine learning models pose a substantial threat to privacy, potentially leaking sensitive information. Although defending against such attacks using differential privacy (DP) provides theoretical guarantees, determining appropriate DP parameters remains challenging.

arxiv-2408-12211.title: Computer-Aided Fall Recognition Using a Three-Stream Spatial-Temporal GCN Model with Adaptive Feature Aggregation
arxiv-2408-12211.creator: Jungpil Shin, Abu Saleh Musa Miah, Rei Egawa, Koki Hirooka, Md. Al Mehedi Hasan, Yoichi Tomioka, Yong Seok Hwang
arxiv-2408-12211.description: Abstract The prevention of falls is paramount in modern healthcare, particularly for the elderly, as falls can lead to severe injuries or even fatalities. Additionally, the growing incidence of falls among the elderly, coupled with the urgent need to prevent suicide attempts resulting from medication overdose, underscores the critical importance of accurate and efficient fall detection methods.

arxiv-2510-06137.title: Origin of trapped intralayer Wannier and charge-transfer excitons in moiré materials
arxiv-2510-06137.creator: Indrajit Maity 1,* , Johannes Lischner 2 , Arash A. Mostofi 2 , Ángel Rubio 3,4,* 1 Department of Chemistry, School of Natural and Environmental Sciences, Newcastle University, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE1 7RU, UK. 2 Departments of Materials and Physics and the Thomas Young Centre for Theory and Simulat
arxiv-2510-06137.description: Abstract Moiré materials offer a versatile platform for engineering excitons with unprecedented control, promising next-generation optoelectronic applications. While continuum models are widely used to study moiré excitons due to their computational efficiency, they often disagree with ab initio many-body approaches, as seen for intralayer excitons in WS 2 /WSe 2 heterobilayers.

arxiv-2601-22970.title: Stabilizing the Q-Gradient Field for Policy Smoothness in Actor–Critic
arxiv-2601-22970.creator: Jeong Woon Lee, Kyoleen Kwak, Daeho Kim, Hyoseok Hwang
arxiv-2601-22970.description: Abstract Policies learned via continuous actor-critic methods often exhibit erratic, high-frequency oscillations, making them unsuitable for physical deployment. Current approaches attempt to enforce smoothness by directly regularizing the policy’s output. We argue that this approach treats the symptom rather than the cause.

arxiv-2602-14716.title: Grid-free linear hypergraphs via Cayley-Bacharach
arxiv-2602-14716.creator: Cosmin Pohoata
arxiv-2602-14716.description: Abstract We give a new construction showing that for every r ≥ 3 r\geq 3 , there exists an r r -uniform linear hypergraph on n n vertices with Θ r ​ ( n 2 ) \Theta_{r}(n^{2}) edges and no copy of the r × r r\times r grid.

britannica-1911-godfrey-sir-edmund-berry.title: Godfrey, Sir Edmund Berry (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-godfrey-sir-edmund-berry.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-godfrey-sir-edmund-berry.description: Article 'Godfrey, Sir Edmund Berry' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. magistrate and politician, younger son of Thomas Godfrey (1586–1664), a member of an old Kentish family, was born on the 23rd of December 1621. He was educated at Westminster school and at Christ Church, Oxford, and after entering Gray’s Inn became a dealer in wood. His business prospered.

kennedy-inaugural-1961.creator: John F. Kennedy
kennedy-inaugural-1961.description: Kennedy's 1961 inaugural address — 'ask not what your country can do for you'.

openalex-w7206151423.title: INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL E EDUCAÇÃO INCLUSIVA
openalex-w7206151423.creator: Daiane de Lourdes Alves Velho, Vanderleia da Rosa de Deus, Danielle Cristina Pazinato, Ana Paula Ribeiro Messias de Andrade, Claudiomiro dos Santos Pereira, Marcos Aurélio Chagas Cardoso

pmc-11441085.title: Dipeptidyl peptidase-4 marks distinct subtypes of human adipose stromal/stem cells with different hepatocyte differentiation and immunoregulatory properties
pmc-11441085.creator: Yu Zhang, Mingxi Hua, Xuqing Ma, Weihong Li, Yuqi Cao, Xueya Han, Xiaowu Huang, Haiyan Zhang
pmc-11441085.description: BackgroundHuman adipose-derived stromal/stem cells (hASCs) play important roles in regenerative medicine and numerous inflammatory diseases. However, their cellular heterogeneity limits the effectiveness of treatment. Understanding the distinct subtypes of hASCs and their phenotypic implications will enable the selection of appropriate subpopulations for targeted approaches in regenerative medicine or inflammatory diseases.

pmc-11631008.title: fMRI used to observe the acute craniocerebral response of esophageal cancer related depressive patients treated by rTMS: Initial experience
pmc-11631008.creator: Jianquan Yang, Wen Guo, Xuezhou Pang, Chuanyu You, Chunyang Zhou, Yan Gui, Daiyuan Ma
pmc-11631008.description: To observe the immediate craniocerebral response, changes of spontaneous nerve activity and functional connection after repeated transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) in esophageal cancer patients with depression (ECPD) by functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), and to explore the therapeutic effect, neuroactivity response and mechanism. Eleven patients with ECPD were enrolled to treated with single rTMS.

pmc-11673640.title: Digitalized 3D Spinal Decompression and Correction Device Improved Initial Brace Corrections and Patients’ Comfort Among Adolescents with Idiopathic Scoliosis: A Single-Centre, Single-Blinded Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11673640.creator: Yi Jie, Mengyao Li, Anqin Dong, Yu-Yan Luo, Chang-Liang Luo, Jing Li, Pengyuan Zheng, Xinmin Zhang, Man Sang Wong, Christina Zong-Hao Ma, Ming Zhang, Ólafur E Sigurjónsson, Chiara Giulia Fontanella, Tanya Levingstone
pmc-11673640.description: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of a novel three-dimensional (3D) spinal decompression and correction device in improving the in-brace correction and patient comfort level for adolescents with idiopathic scoliosis (AIS), and to assess the impact of the number of vertebrae involved in the scoliotic curve on the correction’s effectiveness.

pmc-12433199.title: Metagenomic Next-Generation Sequencing Reveals Porphyromonas gingivalis in Geriatric Severe Pneumonia Complicated by Empyema: Case Report
pmc-12433199.creator: Na Guo, Guannan Ma, Huimin Liu, Jingxuan Qiu, Yan Yu, Yunlei Gao, Zhong Yi, Zhirong Wan, Lei Zhang, Xiaorui Wu
pmc-12433199.description: BackgroundSevere pneumonia with empyema in elderly patients presents diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. Traditional culture methods often fail to identify the causative pathogen, leading to delays in targeted treatment. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) has emerged as a powerful tool for detecting rare and fastidious pathogens.

pmc-12509889.title: Effects of auditory enrichment on Pekin duck production and welfare
pmc-12509889.creator: J.M. Schober, G. Ayres, G. Chambers, E. Stuart, B. Peterson, J. Curry, G.S. Fraley
pmc-12509889.description: Few studies have looked at the effects of auditory enrichment on the production and welfare of poultry species, while none have looked at Pekin ducks specifically. We utilized 400 grow-out Pekin ducks obtained on day-of-hatch from a commercial hatchery and evenly and randomly placed into 4 pens in 3 rooms.

pmc-12606791.title: Differences in symptoms and clinical outcomes of COVID-19 infection across vaccination status and age groups during the national pandemic from December 2022 to February 2023 in China: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12606791.creator: Nan Hua, Ange Wang, Fang Zheng, Wenjing Gao, Qin Zhang, Jing Chen
pmc-12606791.description: BackgroundThe end of the ‘dynamic zero-COVID’ policy on 7 December 2022 caused an immediate Omicron outbreak in China, which is the first nationwide COVID-19 wave in China. We aimed to assess the difference in COVID-related symptoms and clinical outcomes across vaccination status and age groups.MethodsThis was a cross-sectional study. Data were collected via online survey or telephone interview.

pmc-12640667.title: Potent Antisickling Furaldehyde Analogs for Acute Sickle Cell Therapy: Enhanced Efficacy and Intravenous Formulation Potential
pmc-12640667.creator: Abdelsattar M Omar, Moustafa E El‐Araby, Tarek A Ahmed, Akua K Donkor, Albert Opare, Mohini S Ghatge, Anfal S Aljahdali, Rana T Alhashimi, Trevohn N Robinson, Benita Balogun, Mariana Macias, Salma Roland, Yan Zhang, Faik N Musayev, Osheiza Abdulmalik, Martin K Safo
pmc-12640667.description: Sickle cell disease (SCD) is a debilitating inherited blood disorder characterized by acute crises that require immediate intervention. Aromatic aldehydes that increase hemoglobin (Hb) oxygen affinity (e.g., 5‐HMF) can prevent hypoxia‐induced erythrocyte sickling, but clinical efforts have been hindered by insufficient potency or poor pharmacokinetics.

pmc-12784017.title: Biomechanical Evaluation of Anterior Plate Fixation With Cage for Basilar Invagination With Atlantoaxial Dislocation: A Cadaveric Study
pmc-12784017.creator: Jianying Zheng, Zhiping Huang, Kunqi Li, Xuanhang Zhang, Jian Xiong, Yu Wang, Jiahao Xie, Panjie Xu, Zhongmin Zhang, Wei Ji
pmc-12784017.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the biomechanical characteristics of 2 anterior fixation techniques (clival plate fixation [CPF], transoral atlantoaxial reduction plate [TARP]) versus posterior occipitocervical fixation (POCF) for basilar invagination with atlantoaxial dislocation (BI-AAD), under varying atlantoaxial lateral mass cage heights (4–10 mm).

pmc-12785681.title: Low-Fat Cheddar Cheese Influences Gut Microbiota Composition and Diversity in Human Microbiota–Associated Mice
pmc-12785681.creator: Si Lu, Mairui Gao, Deepa Kuttappan, Mary Anne Amalaradjou
pmc-12785681.description: Simple SummaryCheese is one of the most widely consumed fermented dairy foods, yet there is limited experimental evidence on how it influences the gut microbiota. Most previous studies have relied on population surveys or on testing isolated cheese components, rather than cheese as a whole food.

pmc-13119126.title: Effect of High-Salt Diet on Memory and Behavior in Mice Expressing Human Apolipoprotein Epsilon-4 (APOE4) Allele
pmc-13119126.creator: Riad Abdulmoniem, Mia Rivers, Gabriel Carter, Syed J. Khundmiri, Jahn N. O’Neil
pmc-13119126.description: Apolipoprotein epsilon (APOE) is a small molecular protein that regulates lipid and lipoprotein homeostasis. Several reports demonstrated that apolipoprotein epsilon-4 allele (APOE4) expression significantly increases the genetic risk of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and chronic kidney disease. However, there is inconsistent evidence of the association of AD with dietary habits, especially salt intake.

pmc-13176626.title: Flavonoid Inhibition of Bacillus licheniformis LP‐8 Lipase: In Vitro and In Silico Insights Into Anti‐Obesity Potential
pmc-13176626.creator: Songul Bayrak, Mehmet Akif Omeroglu, Halil Senol
pmc-13176626.description: Lipase inhibition is a key strategy for controlling dietary fat absorption and managing obesity. In this study, lipase produced from Bacillus licheniformis LP‐8 (GenBank accession number: PX970421), using waste frying oil, was used to evaluate the inhibitory potential of selected flavonoid compounds. In vitro inhibition assays revealed IC50 values ranging from 1.28 to 3.

pmc-13243018.title: Associations between perceived school climate and close friend support among Chinese high school students: a cross-sectional serial indirect-effect analysis of exercise-related basic psychological needs satisfaction and self-esteem
pmc-13243018.creator: Hanyang Cui, Luhui Li, Wenting Liu
pmc-13243018.description: BackgroundClose friend support is a key emotional and coping resource during adolescence, yet less is known about the psychological variables that may statistically account for its association with students' perceived school climate.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional survey among 1,380 Chinese high school students aged 15–18 years from five senior high schools in Shihezi, Xinjiang, China.

pmc-13423528.title: Short Segment Fixation with Inclusion of the Fractured Vertebra versus Long Segment Fixation for the Treatment of Thoracolumbar Fractures: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13423528.creator: Nikhil Dhage, Vikas C. Jha, Rahul Jain, Anand K. Das, Vivek S. Sinha, Nitish Kumar
pmc-13423528.description: BackgroundThoracolumbar fractures often necessitate surgical stabilization to prevent instability and kyphotic deformity. Long-segment posterior fixation (LSF) provides robust mechanical support, but at the expense of increased surgical morbidity and reduced spinal mobility. Short-segment fixation with inclusion of the fractured level (SSFIFL) has emerged as a motion-preserving alternative with the potential for comparable outcomes.

pmc-13442442.title: Patient-Perceived feasibility of implementing OpenCap smartphone-based motion capture technology to remotely assess musculoskeletal movement in individuals with orthopedic disorders presenting to a rural midwestern tertiary center
pmc-13442442.creator: Holly D. Aitken, Joshua B. Holt, Robert W. Westermann, Jacob M. Elkins, Dallas A. Vanorny, Justin T. Crawmer, Eli S. Gregory, Silvana Velasquez-Marin Mohr, Cole M. Rich, Jessica E. Goetz

pmc-4262987.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central).
